Core Education Management Features

GlobixTech brings attendance, exams, fees, communication, admissions, and reporting together so institutions can run every workflow smoothly.

Student Attendance

Mark attendance by class or subject. Teachers can do it from a mobile and view daily or monthly records instantly.

Student Information

Each student has a full profile, including class, contact, guardian, fees, and academic records, all stored digitally.

Admission & Forms

New student data, online forms, and class placements are managed from one screen. Filter by status or batch.

Academic Activities

Manual academic tasks waste time, cause errors, and require extra staff. With GlobixTech, schools can automate routines like exam shifts and seating plans.

Why GlobixTech Is the Smartest Choice for Educational Institutes

GlobixTech combines smart education management software, mobile access, and reliable support in one simple system made for schools, colleges, and madrasas. From cloud backup to local training, here's why thousands trust GlobixTech to run their academic operations smoothly.

Cloud-Based Platform

No installations or backups needed. Access GlobixTech anytime from mobile, tab, or desktop — everything syncs effortlessly.

Affordable Solution

GlobixTech is designed to reduce the monthly digital operation costs for schools, colleges, and madrasas without compromising quality.

Easy to Use

Clean dashboard, simple menus, and Bangla-English support. No extensive training required for basic day-to-day use.

Safe & Secure

All user roles are protected with advanced permissions. Only authorized users can access sensitive financial or student data.

Strong Local Support

From setup to training, GlobixTech's Bangladesh-based team helps your school stay on track with fast technical assistance.

Instant Updates

Get live updates for attendance, payments, results, or notices — even from home. Everyone stays informed in real-time.

Verified Data Storage

GlobixTech ensures regular data backups and smart storage systems so your institute's academic history stays safe forever.

Full Staff Training

Teachers and admins get onboarding help, plus video guides and FAQs. Everyone can use GlobixTech effectively from Day 1.
